_comment: Final 256 px cell coordinates, measured on the title-style art (quantize-48 packed cells) by Claude 2026-10-11. Hit boxes sit on the striking limb's contact end (fist, palm, foot) padded about 3 px; smear streaks and arcs drawn ahead of or around the limb are left out, so a hit needs the drawn fist or foot to reach the body. Kept auto boxes: light1 f3 (forearm end + fist) and special f5 (the thrust palm). Chidori (special) f3-f4 hit with the leading head/shoulder (SPEC 'Strikes and contact zones'). _scale = the strip's auto-head fit these numbers were measured at (no re-scaling). Round 3 (Claude, 2026-10-12, measured on the title-style art): heavy v11 (bodyHeight 213), throw v07 (bodyHeight 208) and specialUp v09 (auto-head fit x1.0834) re-measured on their packed cells; the other strips' versions and sizes are unchanged since their measurement.
_hands: hand: palm/fingertip point (256 cell) for hand effects, shots and beams; measured by Claude 2026-10-11 on the title-style art from the packed frames: the Chidori lightning hand on every special frame (startup, run, thrust, impact, recovery), the Chidori Sharp Spear's open L palm (specialForward f0-f3; the spear leaves from f2), the raised Kirin palm (beamCharge) and the pointing palm (beamFire, the clash-stream origin). throw f1 is Sasuke's open mouth (v07, re-measured 2026-10-12), the Great Fireball's release point (ANIMATIONS.md), with the raised R fingers just in front of it.

light1._note: f2: the lead fist (x 203-213); the auto box also took the navy smear streak drawn ahead of the fist (x 215-233). f3 keeps the auto box (forearm end + fist).

light2._note: the rear fist reaches only x 207-208 (3 px past the idle guard). f2 auto box took the smear streak ahead of the fist (to x 236); f3 auto box was the front 28% of the body down to the front foot.

light3._note: the kicking foot (sole forward, toes up) at x 236-249, y 98-128; the auto boxes covered the whole shin and the smear wisps (59x43, 58x47).
light3._refit: scaled x1.0537 about the pivot with the strip's bodyHeight 190 -> 200 (size consistency pass, 2026-10-11)

light4._note: the kicking foot at head height; f3's auto box covered the whole white crescent smear (x 196-253, y 71-185), f4's the shin and the guard fist.

heavy._note: v11 at bodyHeight 213 (round 3, 2026-10-12; measured on the packed 48-colour cells): f3 the R foot kicking forward-up (sandal and toes x 224-248, y 63-97; the old v10 box [210, 61, 26, 34] covered only the ankle and heel half), f4 the R foot overhead (x 186-206, y 28-62). f4 sits above a standing defender's hurt box (top y 71): it connects with airborne or taller targets only; f3 is the grounded hit.

airLight1._note: the lead fist; the auto boxes ran from the sleeve (x 194) to the fist (61 and 56 px wide).

airLight2._note: the kicking R foot; the auto rising-strike rule put both boxes on the hair and the rear arm (x 47-131).
airLight2._refit: scaled x0.9785 about the pivot with the strip's bodyHeight 207 -> 203 (size consistency pass, 2026-10-11)

airLight3._note: the kicking heel; f2's auto box covered the white crescent smear (to x 253, down to y 192), f3's the whole lower leg.
airLight3._refit: scaled x0.9643 about the pivot with the strip's bodyHeight 201 -> 194 (size consistency pass, 2026-10-11)

airHeavy._note: the clasped fists; the auto boxes covered the navy smear arc above them (45x99, 41x87). boxPad [0.5, 0.45] still grows them a lot.
airHeavy._refit: scaled x1.0482 about the pivot with the strip's bodyHeight 198 -> 208 (size consistency pass, 2026-10-11)

throw._note: v07 at bodyHeight 208 (round 3, 2026-10-12, measured on the packed cells). No melee box (projectile). f1 is the release frame: the fireball spawns at Sasuke's mouth (lips x 225-228, y 90-93, nose x 230 y 88); the raised R fingers sit just in front of it (x 229-242, y 88-106). The v01 point [208, 89] now lands on the neck.

special._note: v13 with the auto-head fit x0.8711 and f6's -6 px offset, measured on the packed cells. The open R hand holds the lightning: beside the hip on f3, trailing back at chest height on f4. f3-f4 hit with the leading head/shoulder (f4: the head and the forward L fist); f5 keeps the auto box on the thrust palm (the old f5 box sat below it).

specialForward._note: v10 with the auto-head fit x0.8636. Projectile move (no melee): the boxes mark the open L palm; the spear spawns at the f2 hand. The palm is drawn upright, fingers up, not as a level spear-hand.

specialUp._note: v09 with the auto-head fit x1.0834, measured on the packed cells (round 3, 2026-10-12): f2 the R foot rising forward (sandal x 187-202, y 81-109, toes up), f3 the R foot overhead (x 185-199, y 43-70). The v02 boxes, scaled by the fit, sat in empty air above the f2 foot and on the f3 shin. The hit itself is still checked by distance in kit.js.

beamCharge._note: the raised open R palm (Kirin call); the old points sat 55 px right of it in empty air.
beamCharge._refit: scaled x0.9747 about the pivot with the strip's bodyHeight 230 -> 224 (size consistency pass, 2026-10-11)

beamFire._note: the pointing open R palm tip, re-measured by Claude 2026-10-14 on v07 at its auto-head fit x0.8482 (the v06-era points, scaled, sat 17-19 px in front of the palm and 12 px low); the old points sat on the sleeve end 45 px behind it.
